mask.description: Fixed full-time kz/ky kt-Gaussian mask per case/R/seed; shared by all encodings, raw-x slices and methods.

inference.description: Ours emits center t/x; baseline tiles emit each genuine frame/slice once. overlap is available as an explicit alternative.

metrics.description: Historical wrapper settings: bbox and phase-radian flow. Set use_venc=true explicitly for physical velocity units; apply identical settings to every method.
